svg.title: Tailwhip stage 1 schematic
svg.text: Tailwhip stage 1: full schematic. Every pin of every board, by the name printed on the board.
Lines are connections. Every ground symbol is the same net, GND = BMS P-. Grey pins and "nc" are not connected. Wire ids (W..) match the wire list and wiring.svg.
R1, R2, C2 sit on JB: drawn below,
next to the ESP32 pin they feed.
top = antenna end, bottom = USB end. Left: row B, right: row A
AD0 is pulled low on the GY-521: address 0x68.
Tied to 3V3 it would be 0x69 and the firmware
would not find it. SCL/SDA pull-ups are on the
All motor current: BMS -> F1 -> SW1 -> K2 -> JB
-> U4, and back on W12/W8. 22 AWG on that loop.
Slow decay: one IN held high, the other PWM-ed
at 20 kHz. Average motor V = duty x VBAT;
the firmware caps it at 6.0 V (u = 1).
R3/R4 hold IN1/IN2 low while the ESP32 boots,
so the motor stays in coast until setup() runs.
Charge through J1 with SW1 OFF (8.4 V CC/CV).
Ground symbols: ESP32 GND (A14) to U1 OUT- is wire W16; U1 IN- to U4 - is W14; R2, C2 to JB GND are perfboard tracks; R3, R4 to U4 - are their own legs.
Pin tags A1..A19 and B1..B19 count from the antenna end. Wiring.svg shows the same pins as you see them on the robot, counted from the USB end.
